lines.text: Barnaby the busy beaver wanted to build the tallest wooden dam on the river!
Bedtime! called his parents. But Barnaby insisted, Sleeping is a waste of time!
He gnawed on birch logs under the moonlight, refusing to close his drooping eyes!
By sunrise, his head felt heavy as a boulder and his paws turned to wobbly jelly!
He missed a branch, dropped his favorite chisel, and tumbled splash into the river!
Doctor Owl pulled him ashore and explained, Sleep is your body's charging station!
While you snooze, your brain sorts memories and your muscles rebuild superhero strength!
Barnaby curled up for a cozy eight-hour nap and woke up ready to build world wonders!
Recharge your superpower sleep and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
